What kind of price game should Bonjour be?

- **Trading Simulator** - Virtual portfolio with real prices, see how well you can trade
- **Price Guessing** - Guess the exact price of Bitcoin/ETH and see how close you get

- **Price Timing** - Buy/sell at the right moment to maximize virtual profits

- **5 minutes** - Quick but not too rushed
- **15 minutes** - More strategic thinking time
- **1 hour** - Longer-term prediction game

1 minute

Which crypto should players predict on?
- **Bitcoin (BTC)** - Most popular, lots of movement
- **Ethereum (ETH)** - Second most popular
- **Solana (SOL)** - Often more volatile, bigger swings
- **Multiple cryptos** - Let players choose which one to predict
- **Random crypto** - Game picks a different one each round

What do you think would be most engaging?
BTC

- **Streak system** - Points multiply with consecutive correct predictions (1x, 2x, 3x, etc.)
- **Confidence betting** - Players can bet more points if they're confident in their prediction
- **Time bonus** - Extra points for predicting early in the round
- **Leaderboard** - Track high scores and winning streaks

sIMPLE

- **Predict at any time** - Players can make their up/down prediction whenever during the minute
- **Countdown timer** - Show how much time is left in the current round
- **Lock predictions early** - Once you predict, you're locked in for that round
- **Show results immediately** - As soon as the minute ends, show if you were right/wrong and update score

Show live btc

Got it! Live Bitcoin price updates with everything else I mentioned.

One last question: What should the point values be?
- **+10 for correct, 0 for wrong** - Only reward success
- **+10 for correct, -5 for wrong** - Small penalty for wrong guesses
- **+15 for correct, -10 for wrong** - Higher stakes, bigger penalties

What feels right to you?

```javascript
// Helper function — include this in your app
async function pythMCP(toolName, args) {
  // Step 1: Initialize session
  const init = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 0, method: 'initialize',
      params: { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'ouroboros-app', version: '1.0' } }
    })
  });
  await init.json();

  // Step 2: Call the tool
  const res = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call',
      params: { name: toolName, arguments: args }
    })
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  const text = data.result?.content?.[0]?.text || '';
  return JSON.parse(text);
}

// Usage examples:
// Search feeds:     pythMCP('get_symbols', { query: 'bitcoin', limit: 5 })
// Get candles:      pythMCP('get_candlestick_data', { symbol: 'Crypto.BTC/USD', resolution: '60', from: ts - 86400, to: ts })
// Historical price: pythMCP('get_historical_price', { symbols: ['Crypto.BTC/USD'], timestamp: ts })
```

// Helper function — include this in your app
async function pythMCP(toolName, args) {
  // Step 1: Initialize session

    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 0, method: 'initialize',
      params: { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'ouroboros-app', version: '1.0' } }
    })
  });
  await init.json();

  // Step 2: Call the tool
  const res = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call',
      params: { name: toolName, arguments: args }
    })
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  const text = data.result?.content?.[0]?.text || '';
  return JSON.parse(text);
}

// Historical price: pythMCP('get_historical_price', { symbols: ['Crypto.BTC/USD'], timestamp: ts })

// Helper function — include this in your app
async function pythMCP(toolName, args) {
  // Step 1: Initialize session
  const init = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 0, method: 'initialize',
      params: { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'ouroboros-app', version: '1.0' } }
    })
  });
  await init.json();

  // Step 2: Call the tool
  const res = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call',
      params: { name: toolName, arguments: args }
    })
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  const text = data.result?.content?.[0]?.text || '';

// Helper function — include this in your app
async function pythMCP(toolName, args) {
  // Step 1: Initialize session
  const init = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 0, method: 'initialize',
      params: { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'ouroboros-app', version: '1.0' } }
    })
  });
  await init.json();

  // Step 2: Call the tool
  const res = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call',
      params: { name: toolName, arguments: args }
    })
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  const text = data.result?.content?.[0]?.text || '';
  return JSON.parse(text);
}

// Usage examples:
// Search feeds:     pythMCP('get_symbols', { query: 'bitcoin', limit: 5 })
// Get candles:      pythMCP('get_candlestick_data', { symbol: 'Crypto.BTC/USD', resolution: '60', from: ts - 86400, to: ts })

- **Price Timing** - Buy/sell at the right moment to maximize virtual profits

Price prediction

Perfect! A price prediction game it is.

What timeframe should players predict? For example:
- **1 minute** - Fast-paced, immediate results
- **5 minutes** - Quick but not too rushed
- **15 minutes** - More strategic thinking time
- **1 hour** - Longer-term prediction game

1 minute

Great! A 1-minute price prediction game will be exciting and fast-paced.

Which crypto should players predict on?
- **Bitcoin (BTC)** - Most popular, lots of movement
- **Ethereum (ETH)** - Second most popular
- **Solana (SOL)** - Often more volatile, bigger swings
- **Multiple cryptos** - Let players choose which one to predict
- **Random crypto** - Game picks a different one each round

BTC

Perfect! Bitcoin price prediction in 1-minute rounds.

- **Streak system** - Points multiply with consecutive correct predictions (1x, 2x, 3x, etc.)

- **Time bonus** - Extra points for predicting early in the round
- **Leaderboard** - Track high scores and winning streaks

sIMPLE

- **Predict at any time** - Players can make their up/down prediction whenever during the minute
- **Countdown timer** - Show how much time is left in the current round
- **Lock predictions early** - Once you predict, you're locked in for that round
- **Show results immediately** - As soon as the minute ends, show if you were right/wrong and update score

Show live btc

Got it! Live Bitcoin price updates with everything else I mentioned.

- **+10 for correct, 0 for wrong** - Only reward success
- **+10 for correct, -5 for wrong** - Small penalty for wrong guesses
- **+15 for correct, -10 for wrong** - Higher stakes, bigger penalties

async function pythMCP(toolName, args) {
  // Step 1: Initialize session
  const init = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({

      params: { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'ouroboros-app', version: '1.0' } }
    })
  });
  await init.json();

  // Step 2: Call the tool
  const res = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call',
      params: { name: toolName, arguments: args }
    })
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  const text = data.result?.content?.[0]?.text || '';
  return JSON.parse(text);
}

### How to call Pyth MCP from JavaScript:

```javascript
// Helper function — include this in your app
async function pythMCP(toolName, args) {
  // Step 1: Initialize session
  const init = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 0, method: 'initialize',
      params: { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'ouroboros-app', version: '1.0' } }
    })
  });
  await init.json();

  // Step 2: Call the tool
  const res = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call',
      params: { name: toolName, arguments: args }
    })
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  const text = data.result?.content?.[0]?.text || '';
  return JSON.parse(text);
}

// Usage examples:
// Search feeds:     pythMCP('get_symbols', { query: 'bitcoin', limit: 5 })
// Get candles:      pythMCP('get_candlestick_data', { symbol: 'Crypto.BTC/USD', resolution: '60', from: ts - 86400, to: ts })
// Historical price: pythMCP('get_historical_price', { symbols: ['Crypto.BTC/USD'], timestamp: ts })
```

// Helper function — include this in your app
async function pythMCP(toolName, args) {
  // Step 1: Initialize session
  const init = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 0, method: 'initialize',
      params: { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'ouroboros-app', version: '1.0' } }
    })
  });
  await init.json();

  // Step 2: Call the tool
  const res = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call',
      params: { name: toolName, arguments: args }
    })
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  const text = data.result?.content?.[0]?.text || '';
  return JSON.parse(text);
}

```javascript
// Helper function — include this in your app
async function pythMCP(toolName, args) {
  // Step 1: Initialize session
  const init = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 0, method: 'initialize',
      params: { protocolVersion: '2024-11-05', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'ouroboros-app', version: '1.0' } }
    })
  });
  await init.json();

  // Step 2: Call the tool
  const res = await fetch('https://mcp.pyth.network/mcp', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream' },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call',
      params: { name: toolName, arguments: args }
    })
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  const text = data.result?.content?.[0]?.text || '';
  return JSON.parse(text);
}

// Get candles:      pythMCP('get_candlestick_data', { symbol: 'Crypto.BTC/USD', resolution: '60', from: ts - 86400, to: ts })
// Historical price: pythMCP('get_historical_price', { symbols: ['Crypto.BTC/USD'], timestamp: ts })
